description: FAIRY MUSIC v1.0.0 — Pure native music streaming with tactile spring physics, AMOLED dark theme, and direct in-app OTA updates.

changelog.title: Tactile UI & Spring Physics
items: Spring-physics bouncy feedback across all interactive buttons
Fluid screen transitions with zero frame stutter
Breathing neon sweep-gradient ring on Now Playing screen
Rhythmic equalizer visualizer bars on active tracks

changelog.title: Branding & Identity
items: Signature Weird Cat launcher and in-app icons
Top bar branded with FAIRY MUSIC and Dev By D4RK

changelog.title: Direct OTA Updates
items: 1-tap download & install directly inside the app
Real-time download progress tracking & system notifications
